ordering_constraints: L0 must complete before decoder implementation.
L1 must complete before L2 or L3.
L2 must exist before L3 equivalence testing.
L5 may run only after L4 decoder freeze.
V6 checkpoint, decoder, and thresholds freeze before blind-test authorization.

stages.purpose: freeze semantics, constraints, scoring, tie-breaking, and validation grid
generate and verify all 240 directed 4x4 XY routes
implement reduced exhaustive oracle and full exact 4x4 decoder
implement deterministic route-ROM candidate/beam decoder and equivalence tests
select and freeze decoder using B4 validation outputs only
apply the frozen decoder to the frozen B6 cache
integrate route-pair labels and decoder requirements into V6
